prompt.text: Complete this bounded research task exactly: compare JSON and YAML for human-edited configuration. Call research_plan_start with exactly two branches, JSON and YAML, each budget {searches:0, reads:2}. Dispatch the JSON research-planner child first with its context and wait for its terminal branch_plan report; only then dispatch the YAML child and wait for its terminal report. Use sequential single-child dispatch, never parallel or fork mode. The JSON child must read https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc8259 once; the YAML child must read https://yaml.org/ once. Each child must publish done with exactly one source lead and one combined property-and-limitation claim using its original URL, without scouts or a second read. After both reports are terminal, the parent must web_read both lead URLs, record one parent-validated card per lead with each exact claim text, then call plan_settle with a summary shorter than 240 characters. Do not search, add leads, retry a valid child, or broaden. If a source fails, mark only that branch deferred with value, risk, and rationale.

negative_control.text: What are the two JSON structural types? Give a short answer from one official source.
